article: Change the Japanese-English input source shortcut on Mac
scope: Read and compared the complete Japanese article and all twelve translations; checked the current Settings path, default Control-Space shortcuts, Option/Alt terminology, source-vs-mode distinction, removal of extra input sources, metadata, and Apple Support links.
findings: Updated the path from the Ventura-era-only wording to System Settings > Keyboard > Keyboard Shortcuts > Input Sources, with older-version naming explained.
Corrected the article’s conflation of input sources with Japanese input modes; explained how to remove an unwanted source while keeping Japanese - Romaji.
Documented Apple’s default Control + Space and Control + Option + Space behavior and clarified that Option + grave is only an example that can conflict or be unavailable.
Removed empty draft values and duplicate dates; preserved the original publication date (2023-04-04) and added lastmod (2026-11-25).
